title: Carry the Data
goal: The click needs to remember which button. Give the variant somewhere to put it.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: User-Defined Types (Enums)

hints: Look at how the match arm reads the click.
A variant carries its data in brackets, like a function's parameters.
explanation: `Click(i32)` gives the variant one piece of data, which the match arm then binds to `n`. With no brackets at all, `Click` carries nothing and the arm `Event::Click(n)` has nothing to bind, so the compiler rejects it. The form `Click: i32` is not enum syntax. A variant either carries nothing, carries unnamed values in brackets, or carries named fields in braces.
